theme: Max excursion before first retest of the 9:30 candle (sized as % of the opening range)
method: Subject = 9:30-9:45 candle. After it closes, track how far price travels above its high or below its low BEFORE the first wick-back to either extreme. Express that excursion as a % of the opening candle's range.

summary.interpretation: On the typical day, price expands ~37% of the opening range past one extreme before pulling back to retest. About 5.83% of days expand more than the full opening range before retracing.
summary.note: Total day-counter logic produced a -9 in 'instant retest' bucket due to boundary mismatch; the real distribution is the buckets shown above.
